description: Shared path text vectors (SPEC.md section 6.2, issue 148). A plaintext path is 1 to 4096 bytes of UTF-8 with no control character (Unicode category Cc: U+0000 to U+001F and U+007F to U+009F). Each vector's path is "path" repeated "repeat" times (once if absent). Every non-empty path here is otherwise vault-relative (testdata/paths/validity.json), so "valid" is exactly the text rule. "new" is whether a commit may create a document at the path: valid, and within the new-path limits of testdata/paths/validity.json (parts of at most 255 bytes, at most 1024 bytes in all), which every path here otherwise meets; internal/vaultpath.CheckNew and CommitRevision (as a create) must return it exactly. internal/vaultpath.CheckText (Go, used by CommitRevision) and isPathText in plugin/src/core/vaultpath (TypeScript, applied to every path a client receives, including E2EE paths after decryption, which the server cannot check) must return valid exactly as given. Lengths count UTF-8 bytes, not code points or UTF-16 code units.

vectors.name: 2049 two-byte characters (4098 bytes, 2049 UTF-16 code units)
1025 four-byte characters (4100 bytes, 2050 UTF-16 code units)
